learn.title: Learn
learn.purpose: Programme catalogue summary: what each initial and continuing programme covers and how long it runs, with sources.

learn-course.title: Course
learn-course.purpose: Objectives tied to competencies, modality, prerequisites and sessions (sessions for staff only).

my-learning.title: My learning
my-learning.purpose: Assigned and elective training, enrolments, simulator sessions and transcript.

my-plan.title: My development plan
my-plan.purpose: Individual development plan towards a target role.

my-mentoring.title: Mentoring
my-mentoring.purpose: Skills-based mentoring: ranked suggestions with reasons, agreements with skill goals, session logs and close-outs. People decide.

training.title: Training admin
training.purpose: Course builder, sessions, simulator scheduling, JPM evaluator, item bank and cohorts.

training-courses.title: Course builder
training-courses.purpose: SAT-based courses with objectives tied to competencies and role-based mandatory assignment.

training-schedule.title: Sessions
training-schedule.purpose: Sessions, rooms, waitlists, attendance and completion evidence.

training-simulator.title: Simulator booking
training-simulator.purpose: Simulator slots by crew; licence-critical training (COCT, requalification) cannot be displaced by elective use.

training-cohorts.title: Cohorts
training-cohorts.purpose: Cohort views and external course requests with approval.

learn-paths.title: Training paths
learn-paths.purpose: Interactive timelines for each discipline track, from entry to qualification, with personal progress.

learn-path.title: Training path
learn-path.purpose: Stages, gates, courses and qualifications for one track, with where you are now.

my-mentoring-agreement.title: Mentoring agreement
my-mentoring-agreement.purpose: One mentoring agreement: goals, cadence, the session log, private notes and the close-out.

my-mentoring-programme.title: Mentoring programme
my-mentoring-programme.purpose: Programme dashboard for the training manager (aggregates only) and subject-matter expert nominations for line managers.

builder.codeHint: Short unique code, for example TQ-RP-101.
builder.created: Course created as a draft entry.
builder.curriculaBody: A curriculum rule assigns a course to everyone in a job role. Running the sync assigns missing mandatory courses; it never removes completed history.
builder.intro: Build courses using a systematic approach to training: objectives tied to competencies, modules, prerequisites and the evaluation that qualifies.
builder.mandatoryHint: Mandatory courses are assigned by role curriculum and cannot be withdrawn by the learner.
builder.noRules: No curriculum rules for this role yet.
builder.packagingHint: Package standard reported by the learning system.
builder.publicHint: Shows a short summary on the public catalogue. Never include internal procedure detail.
builder.qualifyingHint: Completion needs a passed evaluation released by a qualified evaluator. Pick an evaluation form first.
builder.needForm: A qualifying course needs an evaluation form.
builder.syncBody: Every active person will be assigned the mandatory courses their role requires and does not yet hold. Existing enrolments and history are kept.

cohort.intro: Cohort completion by crew, team or role, curriculum gaps, and approvals for internal and external training.
cohort.matrixNote: Only courses required by each person’s role are shown. A dot means not required for that role.
cohort.noGaps: No curriculum gaps. Everyone holds the courses their role requires.
cohort.pickBody: Choose a grouping and a cohort to see its training matrix.
cohort.syncIntro: People whose role requires courses that have not been assigned yet.
cohort.syncOne: {name} will be assigned the mandatory courses their role requires and does not yet hold.
cohort.synthetic: All people shown are synthetic demo personas.

course.confirmSelf: You will be enrolled in {course}. Your manager is notified for elective courses.
course.confirmSession: You will be booked on {course} on {when}. If the session is full you join the waitlist and are promoted automatically when a seat frees up.
course.electiveNote: Elective courses need your line manager’s approval before a seat is confirmed.
course.evaluationBody: Completion of this course is recorded only after a passed evaluation released by a qualified evaluator. Attendance alone does not complete it.
course.evaluationForm: Evaluation: {form} ({kind}), pass mark {pass}, up to {max} attempts, {wait} days between attempts.
course.internalBody: Session dates, rooms and enrolment are visible to signed-in staff only.
course.noModules: No modules listed for this course.
course.notFoundAnon: This course is not in the public catalogue. Staff can sign in to see internal courses.
course.notFoundStaff: The course may have been retired or the link is wrong.
course.sessionsIntro: Pick a session. Seats are held in order of booking; when a session is full you join its waitlist.
course.withdrawElective: Your place is released and the next person on the waitlist is offered it.
course.withdrawMandatory: This course is required for your role. Withdrawing frees the session seat only; the course stays assigned and you will need to book another session.

hub.assessQueueSub: {items} items in review · {results} results to release · {appeals} appeals
hub.intro: Run the training programme: sessions, simulator time, evaluations and approvals. Kafa’a mirrors the training records system and never replaces it.
hub.noMySessions: No sessions assigned to you this week or next.
hub.waitlistedSub: Promoted automatically when a seat frees

learn.catalogueIntro: Initial and continuing programmes by area, with the courses inside each one.
learn.intro: How people at a nuclear operator are trained: from general employee training to simulator-based licensed operator programmes, leadership and emergency preparedness.
learn.pathsIntro: Follow a track from entry to qualification.
learn.publicNote: Public pages describe programmes at summary level from published reports. Course schedules, procedures and assessment content stay internal.
learn.statGetSub: People in initial and continuing GET

mentor.humanBody: Mentors opt in and decide on each request themselves. Kafa’a does not rank or auto-assign mentors.
mentor.interestsHint: Comma-separated, for example: outage planning, licensing, leadership.
mentor.intro: Opt-in mentoring between colleagues, matched by role and interest.
mentor.messageHint: What would you like help with? Optional, up to 500 characters.
mentor.noRequests: You have not asked for a mentor yet.
mentor.offerBody: Your role and interests are shown to colleagues. You can pause by unticking the opt-in at any time.
mentor.optInHint: Untick to stop receiving new requests.
mentor.matchedBody: You become this colleague’s mentor and your free places drop by one.
mentor.declinedBody: The colleague is told you are unable to mentor now and can ask someone else.
mentor.closedBody: The request is closed for both of you and the place is freed.

my.approveBody: The learner is enrolled, or placed on the waitlist if the session is full.
my.rejectBody: The learner sees your reason. The request cannot be reopened; they can submit a new one.
my.bookConfirm: You will be booked on this session, or placed on its waitlist if it is full.
my.certNote: Certificates are issued only after a recorded completion or a released passed evaluation. Anyone can check one on the verify page.
my.completeBody: Self-paced e-learning is recorded as completed with today’s date and the course hours.
my.externalIntro: Request an external course, conference or certification. Your line manager decides.
my.intro: Your assigned and elective training, sessions, simulator time, transcript and certificates.
my.justificationHint: Link it to your role, plan or a competency gap.
my.noCertsBody: Certificates appear here once a course is completed or an evaluation is passed.
my.noRankBody: Kafa’a does not rank colleagues against each other. Progress is shown against your own requirements only.
my.noRecords: No completed training on record yet.
my.noSessionsBody: Ask the training team to schedule a session, or check back later.
my.simNoCrew: You are not assigned to a shift crew.
my.simNone: No simulator sessions booked for you.
my.transcriptBody: {n} hours on record. The training records system remains the authority; report any error to your training coordinator.

paths.intro: Each discipline has a structured route from entry to qualification. Pick a track to see its stages; signed-in staff also see their own progress.
paths.signInBody: Staff can sign in to see which stages they have completed.

plan.addFirst: Add at least one activity before submitting.
plan.approveBody: The plan becomes active and its activities can start.
plan.createBody: Choose the role you are working towards. Kafa’a shows the competency gap and suggests courses; you and your manager decide.
plan.gapIntro: Required level for the target role compared with your recorded level.
plan.intro: An individual development plan towards a target role, agreed with your line manager.
plan.noGapBody: Your recorded levels meet the target role profile.
plan.notAuthority: A development plan does not change your grade, role or qualifications. Those decisions stay with HR and the qualification process.
plan.returnBody: The plan goes back to draft with your note so the employee can revise it.
plan.submitBody: Your line manager is asked to approve it. You cannot edit activities while it is under review.
plan.suggestIntro: Courses that develop the competencies with the largest gap.
plan.teamIntro: Plans submitted by people you manage.

schedule.attendanceBody: Attendance for {n} people is recorded with your name and time.
schedule.attendanceLater: Attendance opens when the session starts.
schedule.cancelBody: Everyone booked is told and their enrolments return to assigned so they can book again.
schedule.closeBody: The session is marked completed. Anyone not yet completed stays open for follow-up.
schedule.evidenceHint: What was observed. Never record plant-security detail.
schedule.intro: Schedule sessions, manage rosters and waitlists, take attendance and record completion evidence.
schedule.noForm: No evaluation form is linked yet. Add one in the course builder.
schedule.qualifyingNote: This course qualifies. Pass or fail here records the instructor outcome; the qualification is granted only from a released passed evaluation.
schedule.removeBody: {name} loses the seat and the first person on the waitlist is promoted.

sim.blockedBody: Licence-critical training (continuing operator training and requalification) cannot be displaced by a lower-priority booking.
sim.displaceBody: The current {kind} booking will be marked displaced and its owner notified.
sim.gridCaption: Simulator week grid: rows are simulators, columns are days and shifts.
sim.intro: Book full-scope simulator time by crew. Licence-critical training always comes first.
sim.ruleBody: Continuing operator training and requalification hold priority 1 and cannot be displaced. Initial training and maintenance are priority 2; elective use is priority 4.

reasons.mentor_target_role: Works as {role}, one of your target roles
reasons.mentor_same_role: Works in your role ({role}) and knows it from the inside
reasons.different_line: Outside your reporting line: you can speak freely
reasons.skip_level: In your wider reporting line (not your line manager)
reasons.khnp_paired: Works alongside a KHNP counterpart: good for Handover 2030 knowledge transfer
reasons.capacity_full: No free places right now ({cap} in use)

mtr.intro: Find a mentor who has the skills you need, agree goals together, log your sessions and close out with both of you rating what you achieved.
mtr.humanBody: Kafa’a ranks opted-in mentors by how well their skills close your gaps, your target roles, the kind of mentoring you want and their free places, and shows why. Mentors still decide on every request. Your own line manager is never suggested: mentoring works across reporting lines.
mtr.focusLabel: Skills you want help with (up to five)
mtr.noGaps: No gaps against your role and targets: browse all mentors instead.
mtr.ownManagerNote: Your line manager ({role}) offers mentoring but is not suggested to you: mentoring works across reporting lines.
mtr.noMatchesBody: Try another kind of mentoring or browse all mentors.
mtr.fullNote: {n} more mentors match but have no free places right now.
mtr.smeSkill: Subject-matter expert skill (nominated by the mentor’s line manager)

typeHint.career: your next role and how to get there
typeHint.knowledge_transfer: tacit know-how from an experienced specialist
typeHint.reverse: a newer colleague coaches you on digital tools and AI
typeHint.peer_onboarding: a buddy for your first months

mtr.notMentor: You have not offered to mentor yet
mtr.proposedToYou: {n} agreement proposals are waiting for your answer
mtr.agreementsAsMentee: Agreements where I am the mentee
mtr.agreementsAsMentor: Agreements where I am the mentor
mtr.noIncoming: No requests have been sent to you.
mtr.noOffer: You have not offered to mentor. Colleagues value it: offer the skills you hold at practitioner level or above.
mtr.youAreSme: Nominated as a subject-matter expert on {date}
mtr.smeReadOnly: Your subject-matter expert nomination is recorded by your line manager and cannot be changed here.
mtr.offerBody: Colleagues see your role, the kinds of mentoring you offer and the skills you can help with. Offer only skills you hold at practitioner level (3) or above.
mtr.offerSkills: Skills you can help with (up to eight)
mtr.offerSkillsHint: Listed from your skills passport where you are at level 3 or above.
mtr.offerNoSkills: Your passport shows no skill at level 3 or above yet.
mtr.skillsLabel: Skills you want help with (up to {n})
mtr.requestConsequence: The mentor ({role}) sees your request, the kind of mentoring and the skills you named, and decides whether to accept.
mtr.proposeBody: Agree up to five goals, each tied to a skill and a target level, how often you will meet and for how long. The other person accepts or returns it.
mtr.goalTextHint: Up to 200 characters, in your own words.
mtr.proposeConsequence: The other person is notified and accepts or returns the agreement. Accepted agreements are recorded in the evidence ledger.
mtr.notFoundBody: Only the two people in a mentoring pair can open its agreement.
mtr.waitingOther: Waiting for the other person to accept
mtr.waitingYou: This agreement is waiting for your answer
mtr.proposedBody: Check the goals, cadence and dates. Accepting starts the mentoring; returning lets the proposer revise it.
mtr.returnedBody: The proposer can revise it and propose again.
mtr.closingYou: Your mentoring partner has submitted their close-out
mtr.closingBody: The agreement closes when both of you have rated the goals.
mtr.attainmentSub: share of goal ratings at met or exceeded
mtr.attainmentLater: shown when both of you close out
mtr.goalsBody: Each goal names a skill and the level you are aiming for.
mtr.progressBody: {n} sessions logged; {due} expected by now; {total} planned in all.
mtr.closeSummaryBody: {pct}% of the goal ratings were at least “{met}”.
mtr.validatedSummary: {n} of the mentee’s skill claims were validated by the subject-matter expert mentor.
mtr.sessionsBody: Topics, skills and shared notes are visible to both of you.
mtr.noSessionsBody: Log each conversation: date, length, the skills you worked on and a shared note.
mtr.privacy: Private notes are stored separately and only their author can read them: not your partner, not managers, not administrators.
mtr.heldOnHint: Between the start of the agreement and today.
mtr.topicsHint: A short line, up to 300 characters. Shared with your partner.
mtr.privateNoteHint: Only you can ever read this note.
mtr.closeBodyMentee: Rate how far each goal was met. Your mentor rates the same goals; the agreement closes when you have both submitted.
mtr.closeBodyMentor: Rate how far each goal was met. The mentee rates the same goals; the agreement closes when you have both submitted.
mtr.closeNoteHint: What went well, and what to keep practising.
mtr.validateLabel: Validate the mentee’s open skill claims on goals I rated met or exceeded
mtr.validateHint: As a manager-nominated subject-matter expert you can raise a claim to “validated” for your nominated skills. Skills verified only by qualification and security skills are never changed.
mtr.notSmeBody: Only a mentor nominated as a subject-matter expert by their line manager can validate the mentee’s skills at a knowledge-transfer close-out. Your ratings are still recorded.
mtr.closeConsequence: Your ratings are shared with your partner. When both of you have submitted, the agreement closes and the place is freed.
mtr.closeConsequenceValidate: Your ratings are shared with your partner, and the mentee’s open claims on goals you rated met or exceeded become “validated” on their skills passport. This is recorded in the evidence ledger.
mtr.acceptConsequence: The mentoring starts with these goals, cadence and dates. Both of you can then log sessions.
mtr.returnConsequence: The proposer is told and can revise the agreement.

prog.intro: How mentoring is used across the organisation, as aggregates only. Cells with fewer than 10 pairs are suppressed. Individual agreements, sessions and notes are never shown here.
prog.aggOnlyTitle: Programme figures are for the training manager
prog.aggOnlyBody: As a line manager you can nominate subject-matter expert mentors in your own line below.
prog.completionSub: closed out of closed and overdue
prog.attainmentSub: goal ratings at met or exceeded, closed pairs
prog.byTypeBody: Suppressed when fewer than {n} pairs stand behind a cell.
prog.nominateBody: Nominate mentors in your line as subject-matter experts, for the skills they offer. Only a nominated expert can validate skills at a knowledge-transfer close-out.
prog.noNomineesBody: Colleagues you line-manage appear here when they offer to mentor.
prog.nominateConsequence: {name} becomes a subject-matter expert mentor for the skills you choose and can validate skills at knowledge-transfer close-outs. Recorded in the evidence ledger.
prog.withdrawConsequence: {name} stops being a subject-matter expert mentor. Validations already made stay on record.
prog.smeSkillsHint: Leave all unticked to cover every skill the mentor offers.
